faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Associate - I position at CSIR NIO is 02 August 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc degree in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Chemistry (ES-MS), Hydrochemistry, or Marine Chemistry to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by CSIR NIO.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate - I position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate - I role will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: CSIR NIO has announced a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Associate - I position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates can apply for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - I recruitment through the online mode only.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate - I role?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Project Associate - I position will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for the Project Associate - I position is Kochi, Kerala.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this CSIR NIO recruitment is SSP3621/3284-28.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position. The job type for the Project Associate - I role is contractual.
